name: extract-email-validation
prompt: The email checks are copy-pasted in src/handlers/signup.js, src/handlers/invite.js and src/handlers/profile.js. Extract them into a new module src/validation/email.js that exports normalizeEmail(raw) (trims and lowercases) and isValidEmail(email), and make all three handlers use it. The handlers must no longer contain their own email regex. Behaviour must not change.
